content:
Complete the following steps to conﬁgure an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base so that Amazon Q
can create insights for OpenSearch Service alerts.

children: Step 1: Create the LambdaInvokeOpenSearchMLCommonsRole IAM role
Step 2: Map the LambdaInvokeOpenSearchMLCommonsRole role to the OpenSearch Service ml_full_access role
Step 3: Conﬁgure an OpenSearch Service knowledge base using CloudFormation
